purpose: Dependencies: none on Linux and macOS; on Windows the windows-curses package, which gives Python its curses module.
details: A single line with an environment marker (sys_platform == 'win32', version 2.4 or newer). leeravontuur.py tells the user to run `pip install -r requirements.txt` when curses is missing; the CI workflow installs it before the tests. The program otherwise uses only the standard library.
